policies.label: pending_transfer

policies.hypothesis: Settlement queue, compliance review or transfer-processing delay
policies.text: A transfer marked pending has not reached a confirmed final state. Check submission time, processing status, any review flag and the payment rail's operating window before escalating.
questions: What payment rail and submission time apply?

policies.action: Trace the transfer reference and provide a status tied to the payment rail.
policies.prevention: Review queue monitoring, delayed-transfer alerts and case ownership.

title: A card payment I did not make
text: There is a card payment for Rs 8600 to a merchant I do not recognize. I did not authorize this transaction and my card is still with me. I am worried about more charges.
label: card_payment_not_recognised

I am worried about more charges.

hypothesis: Possible unauthorized card use or an unfamiliar merchant descriptor
questions: Does the customer recognize the merchant's trading name?
Was a supplementary card or recurring subscription used?
Has the customer already frozen the affected card?

actions.title: Use the bank's secure channel to protect the card and investigate the disputed transaction.

policies.label: card_payment_not_recognised
policies.title: Unrecognized card payment
policies.hypothesis: Possible unauthorized card use or an unfamiliar merchant descriptor
policies.text: Treat an unrecognized card payment as a security concern. First check the merchant descriptor and any authorized supplementary-card use. If the customer still denies the transaction, route it for a fraud investigation; the complaint itself does not prove fraud.
questions: Does the customer recognize the merchant's trading name?
Was a supplementary card or recurring subscription used?
Has the customer already frozen the affected card?
policies.action: Use the bank's secure channel to protect the card and investigate the disputed transaction.
policies.prevention: Review transaction monitoring and the clarity of merchant descriptors after investigation.

policies.label: pending_card_payment
policies.title: Pending card payment
policies.hypothesis: Merchant capture delay or an outstanding authorization
policies.text: A pending card payment is an authorization, not necessarily a completed debit. Check the merchant capture and authorization-release timestamps. Do not promise a refund or a fixed release time without the applicable bank policy.
questions: When was the payment authorized?
Has the merchant submitted a capture or reversal?
What release rule applies to this transaction?
policies.action: Trace the authorization and communicate the actual transaction status.
policies.prevention: Monitor aging authorizations and improve pending-payment explanations.

policies.label: Refund_not_showing_up
policies.title: Refund not received
policies.hypothesis: Refund initiation, payment-network processing or ledger-posting delay
policies.text: A merchant saying a refund was issued does not establish that it settled. Request the merchant refund reference, initiation date and network trace, then check bank posting. Avoid an unsupported promise about refund timing.
questions: Has the merchant supplied a refund reference?
When was the refund actually initiated?
Can the refund be located in network and ledger records?
policies.action: Trace the merchant refund reference through the network to the account ledger.
policies.prevention: Improve refund tracking and explain initiation versus settlement.
